player_prompt.intro:
Inwe ni Player {player_id} katika mchezo wa {num_rounds}-round wa Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Lengo lako ni kushinda raundi nyingi iwezekanavyo.
Katika kila raundi, jibu na moja ya haya: '[rock]', '[paper]', au '[scissors]'.
Unaweza pia kutumia '[r]', '[p]', au '[s]' kama njia fupi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Temo timore e ng'ane. Ise [rock], [paper], kana [scissors].

outcome.p0_wins: Jaloch mar 0 ema ne olocho e tuke mang'eny!
outcome.p1_wins: Jaloch mar 1 ema ne olocho e tuke mang'eny!
